senses.gloss: शात 1. śā-ta, pp. (√ 2. śā) sharp etc..

शात 3. śāta, n. (?) joy, delight (rare).
सत्त sat-tá, pp. (√ sad) sitting.
सत्ता sat-tā, f. being, existence: -vat, a. 🞄entitled to the predicate ‘being.’

सात sā-tá, pp. san;
 m. N. of a Yakṣa.
शतृ ś-at-ṛ, participial suffix -at (gr.).
सत्तृ sát-tṛ, m. sitter, esp. at the sacrifice 🞄(RV.).

शतेन्द्रिय śatá‿indriya, a. having a hundred 🞄senses (Br.);
 -īśa, m. chief of a hundred 🞄(villages).

शतोति śatá‿ūti, a. bringing a hundred aids 🞄(V.).
शत्य śat-ya, a. consisting of a hundred.

शत्रु śát-ru, m. [overthrower: √ śat] enemy, 🞄rival (V., C.);
 natural foe, immediately contiguous 🞄king (in policy, C.).
शत्रूय śatrū-ya, den. only pr. pt. -yát, behaving 🞄as a foe, hostile (V.).
शातकौम्भ śātakaumbha, a. (ī) id..

शातक्रतव śātakratav-a, a. (ī) relating to 🞄Indra (Śatakratu): with śarāsana, n. rainbow;
 🞄with āśā, f. east.
शातपथ śātapatha, a. (ī) relating or belonging 🞄to, based on, the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa.
शातमन्यव śātamanyav-a, a. (ī) relating or 🞄belonging to Indra (Śatamanyu): w. āśā, f. 🞄east.
शातह्रद śātahrada, a. peculiar to lightning 🞄(śatahradā).
शातातप śāta‿ātapa, m. N. of a lawgiver.
शातिन् śāt-in, a. [√ śat] clipper (of wings, —˚).
शातोदर śāta‿udara, a. (ī) slender-waisted.
षत्व ṣa-tva, n. ṣ-ness, change of s to ṣ.
सतत्त्व sa-tattva, n. real nature: -tas, ad. 🞄in reality.
सतस् sa-tas, ad. equally (only ˚—).

सताप sa-tāpa, a. full of pain;
 -timira, a. 🞄enveloped in darkness.
सति sati, f. a metre.

साति sā-tí, f. (RV.) acquisition, gain, property;
 🞄winning of spoil.

सतोबृहत् sató-bṛhat, a. equally high or 🞄great (V.): -ī, f. a metre (12 + 8 + 12 + 8 syllables);
 🞄-mahat, a. equally great (RV.¹).

सत्त्रायण sattra‿ayaṇá, n. sacrificial session 🞄lasting several years (Br.): -rūpa, n. characteristic 🞄of a long sacrificial session.
सत्यापन satyā-p-ana, (den.) n. ratification 🞄(of a bargain etc.).
सत्यापय satyā-p-aya, cs. den. (fr. satya) 🞄P. ratify.
सत्रप sa-trapa, a. ashamed, bashful: -m, 🞄ad. bashfully.

सत्राजित् satrā-jit, a. thoroughly victorious 🞄(V.);

सत्रासम् sa-trāsam, ad. with terror, timidly;
